evidence_level: small synthetic pilot with hypothetical calibrated optics and sensor
user_objective: one common-FOV frame -> filter-channel images -> continuum color temperature plus CH/C2/AlO-region emission maps; advanced traditional inverse reconstruction combined with neural priors
filter_model: unit top-hat transmission, flat known photon QE; nine-node band integration; provisional centers and widths, no hardware choice

model.boundary: periodic finite-grid pilot; common object PSF across bands

design.feature_synthesis: independent nonnegative spatial emission added to the three visible passbands; diagonal band injections are an engineering control, not measured molecular spectra
design.truth: total post-object-PSF passband images; effective color temperature fitted to the three noiseless thermal images; injected post-PSF emission also retained
design.temperature_reference: fit band-integrated photon Planck radiance with one nonnegative gray amplitude per pixel; range 1800-4500 K; no gas-temperature claim
design.feature_readout: decoded visible images minus extrapolated fitted continuum, in electrons; compare both to noiseless readout and to actual injected post-PSF emission
design.detection: excess divided by raw-derived upstream per-band noise scale; per-method and per-channel 99th-percentile threshold from all blank calibration frames; held-out false-positive fraction reported separately by light level, and sensitivity on injected pixels above 20 percent of the active map mean
design.primary_point: mean 800 nm continuum 4000 electrons, all_weak condition
design.heldout_use: evaluate once after validation choices and calibration thresholds are frozen; no adaptive tuning on these mothers

traditional.objective: original variance-weighted raw least squares plus per-channel isotropic spatial TV and fixed optical support
traditional.parameter_selection: frozen value from base9719bdc, no new lambda search
traditional.numerics: common convergence-certified anchor with fixed400 reference separately retained

predeclared_success.purpose: development screen for continuation, not hardware or scientific generalization acceptance
predeclared_success.seed_rule: one seed811 development only; formal3-seed claim requires later independent runs after a positive pilot

metric_definitions.band_relative_L2: per-frame full-image L2 error divided by full-image truth norm, then mean across frames
metric_definitions.temperature_RMSE: pooled over every held-out pixel and frame in the declared stratum
metric_definitions.emission_RMSE: per channel, pooled over every pixel and frame in the declared stratum against actual post-PSF injection
metric_definitions.paired_injection_slope: inner product of weak-minus-blank output with injected truth divided by squared truth norm, averaged over paired frames
metric_definitions.blank_FPR: fraction of all blank pixels exceeding a threshold frozen using separate calibration mothers; report each channel and count level

physical_stress_controls: two-temperature exposure mixture vs single-temperature fit
hypothetical AlO-region emission also entering the C2-region at 25 percent
unknowns: actual emitting phase and line-of-sight temperature distribution
measured filter transmission and incidence-angle response
actual photon counts at the requested exposure

resources.long_job_rule: verify correct progress and set one wake, no continuous monitoring
resources.local_download: source, reports, plots and weights only; large caches stay on server

solver.objective: fixed estimated shot/read/quantization-variance weighted raw least squares plus spatial isotropic TV of each band, constrained to the common optical frequency support
solver.weight_source: re-encoded FFT initialization; no ground-truth variance
solver.solver: ADMM with matrix-free preconditioned CG; constant-weight Fourier diagonal-plus-rank-one normal operator as preconditioner
solver.selection: lowest validation mean per-band relative L2 among FFT, converged weighted least squares and TV; also retain a network-off control with the same three physical proximal stages
solver.numerical_audit: repeat selected TV on two validation observations at double iteration count; report output change and stationarity, do not label an unconverged reference converged

development_scope: 64/16/8/16 new mothers, one seed; implementation and controlled development before the proposed 256/32/32/64 formal study
training_loss_scales: fixed 3000 K band-integrated photon spectrum divided by its three-NIR mean for channel/mean losses; 50 K temperature, 0.02 log ratio, 0.05 shared raw normalization emission/pair

software_gates.float32_gradient_gate: both0/.3 proposal points; FP32 finite difference h0.05 and0.1 each<3percent; lifted identical-coefficient FP64 AD mismatch<1e-4 and FP64 FD h1e-4<.002; failed h.002 preserved as diagnostic

traditional_reference: same lambda 0.003 and objective; shared convergence-certified anchor up to4000 iterations, original400-iteration output retained and reported separately
detail_metric: centered error / sqrt(centered truth energy+1e-4 total truth energy), declared radiance floor for newly included flat fields
runtime_truth_boundary: MODEL_KEYS passes only raw/calibration-derived tensors; targets and paired blank are never model inputs
provenance_scope: old exposed192-frame heldout excluded; all2496 new raw/anchors pre-generated, neural evaluation only after checkpoint/threshold freeze

recovery.reason: server restart; original journal stops4182, no EXIT/COMPLETION
recovery.recovery_rule: native exact replay failed in software-only recovery001; restart only unfinished grouped_post from frozen seed811 and complete6000, then new full/no_pair6000 each
recovery.future_restart: atomic model/AdamW/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG/best/validation state every200updates; GPU subsequent arithmetic is not guaranteed bitwise deterministic
